queries.title: Trace status totals
queries.question: How many Astra notebook task attempts are in the imported scope, and how many ended in success or error?

queries.title: Failed attempt details
queries.question: Which imported task attempts failed? Return their trace ID, session ID, turn number, duration, error type, and tool count.

queries.title: Latest attempt per session
queries.question: What is the latest recorded task attempt in each imported Astra session?

queries.title: Longest task attempt
queries.question: Which task attempt took the longest, and what were its status, duration, tool count, and model-round count?

queries.title: Tool usage summary
queries.question: Across all imported traces, how many successful and failed calls were recorded for each tool name?

queries.title: Failed tool calls
queries.question: Which individual tool calls failed? Return the trace ID, tool name, tool index, and recorded duration.

queries.title: Token usage by trace
queries.question: Report the recorded input, output, and cache-read tokens for each trace. Which trace has the largest input-plus-output total?

queries.title: Generation count and P95 latency
queries.question: For each trace, how many LLM generations were recorded and what is their nearest-rank P95 duration in milliseconds?

queries.title: Slowest tool calls
queries.question: What are the five slowest recorded tool calls across the imported traces?

queries.title: Success versus error comparison
queries.question: Compare successful and failed task attempts using average duration, tool count, input tokens, and output tokens. Do not claim statistical significance.

queries.title: Later success after failure
queries.question: For each failed trace, was there a strictly later successful trace in the same session? If so, return the earliest one and the time gap.

queries.title: Session execution timeline
queries.question: Build the ordered execution timeline for each session, including turn number, status, start time, duration, and trace ID.

queries.title: Final output availability
queries.question: Which traces contain a nonblank final output? Report Unicode character length and summarize available versus missing outputs.

queries.title: Notebook versions referenced
queries.question: Which hourly_h3_analysis notebook versions are mentioned in each trace's input, output, or tool previews?

queries.title: Canonical data quality audit
queries.question: Audit the imported trace structure: counts, missing model/output/usage fields, root-span counts, parent links, and timestamp ordering.
